title: Sample: Investigate high disk usage on an EC2 instance
summary: Identify disk pressure, recover safe space, and verify filesystem health.
symptoms: Filesystem usage approaches its configured capacity.
Applications report write failures or reduced availability.

root_cause.details: A growing application log or temporary data may be consuming filesystem capacity; confirm with filesystem and directory usage checks.

prerequisites: Approved access to the instance through the organization's normal access process.
Confirm the affected mount and service owner before cleanup.
investigation_steps: Check filesystem capacity and inode usage for the affected mount.
Identify the largest directories and recently growing files.
Review service logs and recent deployment or workload changes.
resolution_steps: Follow the owning service's retention procedure to rotate or remove verified disposable files.
If capacity must be increased, follow the approved volume expansion and filesystem grow procedure.
verification_steps: Confirm filesystem capacity and inode availability have recovered.
Verify the affected service can write and passes its health checks.
rollback_steps: Restore retained files from the approved backup if cleanup removed required data.
If a volume change caused an issue, follow the platform's documented volume recovery procedure.
prevention: Configure log rotation and retention for application logs.
Alert on filesystem capacity and inode thresholds.
